description: Paginated curated housewarming starters. On amazon.se items may include /dp/ASIN buy links; elsewhere catalogMode is search-ideas. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Search remains primary. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED.

name: get_catalog
title: Curated kit catalog
